changelog:
v4.2.17 — Required update: the service moved to a new server

• Please install this update. The service has moved to a new server and the old one has already been switched off, so versions before 4.2.17 can no longer load anything at all.

• You do NOT need to sign in again. The app moves your existing login to the new server by itself the first time it opens after updating. Your username and password are unchanged.

• Your favorites and Continue Watching are kept. Anything the new server no longer carries will simply drop off the list over time.

• Recommendations rebuild themselves. Rows like "For You" start fresh and fill back in over the next few days of normal watching.

• Parental controls carry over. Blocked categories are matched to the new server automatically, and adult categories stay blocked throughout the changeover.

• Heads-up while your provider finishes moving over: live channels are coming back first, and not every channel is across yet. Movies and series are still being migrated and will return over the next little while. Nothing is wrong with your app or your account — a title that won't play today should play once it lands on the new server.

• First launch after updating may take a few extra seconds while channel and movie lists reload. That is a one-time cost.

Includes everything from v4.2.16 and earlier: live channels no longer spin forever when a stream stops delivering, the Dolby 5.1 tuning crash fix, clearer messages for titles your provider hasn't uploaded, and season and episode numbers on every screen.
